     9	/-!
    10	# Finite subsets in affine opens
    11	
    12	`Scheme.FiniteInAffine X` is the action-free geometric condition behind the
    13	finite-Galois quotient construction: every finite subset of `X` lies in one
    14	affine open.  For a finite Galois extension, this immediately supplies
    15	`SemilinearGalAction.OrbitsInAffineOpen` for every action on `X`.
    16	
    17	The property is stated independently of Picard data.  In particular, it is a
    18	conclusion to be proved for a representing scheme, not an additional field of
    19	the representability datum.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory
    27	open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    30	
    31	/-- Every finite subset of a scheme is contained in a single affine open. -/
    32	def FiniteInAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop :=
    33	  ∀ s : Set X, s.Finite → ∃ U : X.affineOpens, s ⊆ U.1
    34	
    35	/-- An affine scheme satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    36	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    37	    FiniteInAffine X :=
    38	  fun _ _ ↦ ⟨⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩, fun _ _ ↦ trivial⟩
    39	
    40	/-- `FiniteInAffine` is invariant under isomorphism. -/
    41	theorem finiteInAffine_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    42	    (h : FiniteInAffine X) : FiniteInAffine Y := by
    43	  intro s hs
    44	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (e.hom.base ⁻¹' s)
    45	    (hs.preimage (TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Scheme.forgetToTop).mapIso e)).injective.injOn)
    46	  refine ⟨⟨e.hom ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion e.hom⟩, ?_⟩
    47	  intro y hy
    48	  exact ⟨e.inv.base y, hU (by simpa using hy), by simp⟩
    49	
    50	/-- `FiniteInAffine` descends along an affine morphism. -/
    51	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isAffineHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    52	    [IsAffineHom f] (h : FiniteInAffine Y) : FiniteInAffine X := by
    53	  intro s hs
    54	  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := h (f.base '' s) (hs.image _)
    55	  exact ⟨⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩, fun x hx ↦ hU ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    56	
    57	/-- An object affine over a field spectrum satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/
    58	theorem finiteInAffine_left_of_isAffineHom {k : Type u} [Field k]
    59	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsAffineHom X.hom] :
    60	    FiniteInAffine X.left :=
    61	  haveI := isAffine_of_isAffineHom X.hom
    62	  finiteInAffine_of_isAffine _
    63	
    64	/-- `FiniteInAffine` supplies the orbit condition for every finite-Galois
    65	semilinear action on the scheme. -/
    66	theorem orbitsInAffineOpen_of_finiteInAffine
    67	    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    68	    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    69	    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    70	    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (h : FiniteInAffine X) :
    71	    rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen where
    72	  exists_affineOpen x := by
    73	    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    74	      h (Set.range fun gamma : L ≃ₐ[K] L ↦ (rho.act gamma).hom.base x)
    75	        (Set.finite_range _)
    76	    exact ⟨U, fun gamma ↦ hU ⟨gamma, rfl⟩⟩
    77	
    78	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The finite-stage Picard glue as a scheme over its field of definition
    10	
    11	The finite-stage glue package already contains affine algebras over its final finite
    12	subextension `P.N.1`.  Their structure maps agree on overlaps, so they descend to the
    13	glued scheme.  This retains the finite-stage object over `Spec P.N.1`, which is the
    14	object-level input for the scalar-extension comparison with the separably closed atlas.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    33	
    34	set_option linter.style.setOption false
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- Projecting the dependent scalar towers from `P` requires a larger local synthesis budget.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The structure map from the finite-stage glued scheme to its field of definition. -/
    39	noncomputable def gluedMap
    40	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    42	    P.glueData.glued ⟶ Spec (.of P.N.1) := by
    43	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.L.1 k := by infer_instance
    44	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic P.M.1 k := by infer_instance
    45	  let A : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u := fun U =>
    46	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U
    47	  let B : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C -> Type u :=
    48	    fun U V =>
    49	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V
    50	  let r : ∀ U V, A U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    51	    pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    52	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    53	  letI : ∀ U V, Algebra (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    54	    pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap (r U V)
    55	  letI : ∀ U V, IsScalarTower P.N.1 (A U) (B U V) := fun U V =>
    56	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap (r U V)
    57	  let tau : ∀ U V, B V U →ₐ[P.N.1] B U V := fun U V =>
    58	    pic0FiniteStageTransitionBaseChange
    59	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    60	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
    61	  · intro U
    62	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U
    63	    exact Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U)))
    64	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
    65	    change Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C at U V
    66	    change
    67	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A U) (B U V))) ≫
    68	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A U))) =
    69	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau U V).toRingHom) ≫
    70	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A V) (B V U)))) ≫
    71	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 (A V)))
    72	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    73	    rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    74	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    75	    congr 1
    76	    ext x
    77	    simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    78	      ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    79	      AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc, RingHom.coe_coe]
    80	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A U) (B U V)]
    81	    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1 (A V) (B V U)]
    82	    exact (tau U V).commutes x |>.symm
    83	
    84	/-- The finite-stage Picard glue, retained over the finite field `P.N.1`. -/
    85	noncomputable def gluedOver
    86	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    87	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) : Over (Spec (.of P.N.1)) :=
    88	  Over.mk P.gluedMap

    90	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage

    92	end
    93	
    94	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite subsets of irreducible algebraic groups lie in affine opens
    12	
    13	This file formalizes the irreducible, algebraically closed core of
    14	[Stacks, Lemma 39.8.6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B7S). Translation
    15	turns one affine neighborhood of the identity into finitely many dense open
    16	subsets. Irreducibility gives a common closed point, and translating back gives
    17	one affine open containing the prescribed rational points.
    18	
    19	The final theorem applies this argument to arbitrary finite sets of topological
    20	points: local finite type over a field makes the scheme Jacobson, so each point
    21	specializes to a closed point. It deliberately does not assert the remaining
    22	arbitrary-field or reducible-component descent.

     8	/-!
     9	# Base change of the finite-stage Picard charts
    10	
    11	Each chart inclusion in the finite-stage glue lies over its affine structure map.
    12	After extending from the final finite subextension to the separably closed field,
    13	the affine pullback formula and the final ring comparison identify that chart with
    14	the corresponding chart in the exact Picard atlas.
    15	-/

    18

    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    33	
    34	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    35	-- Projecting the package retains the nested finite-subextension scalar towers.
    36	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    37	/-- Every finite-stage chart inclusion lies over the chart's affine structure map. -/
    38	@[reassoc]
    39	theorem glueData_ι_gluedMap
    40	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    42	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    43	    P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
    44	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    45	        (algebraMap P.N.1
    46	          (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    47	            C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))) := by
    48	  unfold gluedMap
    49	  exact Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _
    50	
    51	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    52	-- The composite infers the same nested tensor-product instances as the ring comparison.
    53	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    54	/-- Base change of a finite-stage affine chart recovers the corresponding chart in the
    55	exact separably closed Picard atlas. -/
    56	noncomputable def chartBaseChangeIso
    57	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    58	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    59	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    60	    pullback
    61	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    62	          (algebraMap P.N.1
    63	            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    64	              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
    65	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
    66	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).X U :=
    67	  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫
    68	    pullbackSpecIso P.N.1 k
    69	      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    70	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U) ≪≫
    71	    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
    72	      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    73	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
    74	          (Sum.inl U)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op ≪≫
    75	    U.1.2.isoSpec.symm
    76	
    77	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    78	
    79	end
    80	
    81	end AlgebraicGeometry

    12	
    13	The exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer is a group scheme over a field, hence is

    15	atlas is itself affine.  The canonical affine overlap packaged here is the geometric input
    16	for spreading out the finite atlas's restriction maps and gluing data.

    41	/-- Pairwise intersections of charts in the chosen finite atlas of the exact separably

    43	the represented Picard functor, rather than adding separatedness as a hypothesis. -/
    44	theorem pic0FiniteStageAtlas_inter_isAffine

    51	    constructor
    52	    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from J.hom]
    53	    infer_instance
    54	  exact U.1.2.inf V.1.2

    56	/-- The intersection of two chosen finite-stage charts, regarded canonically as an affine
    57	open of the exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer. -/
    58	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap
    59	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    60	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.affineOpens :=

     9	/-!
    10	# Finitely presented algebras at finite subextensions
    11	
    12	A finitely presented algebra over an algebraic field extension is defined over a finite
    13	intermediate extension.  The descended algebra is given explicitly by finitely many generators
    14	and finitely many relations.

    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.DatG0
    24	
    25	/-- The algebra presented by `n` generators and the finite family `relation` of relations. -/
    26	abbrev FiniteRelationAlgebra (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n m : ℕ)
    27	    (relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) : Type u :=
    28	  MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range relation)
    29	
    30	instance finitePresentation_finiteRelationAlgebra
    31	    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n m : ℕ)
    32	    (relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    33	    Algebra.FinitePresentation R (FiniteRelationAlgebra R n m relation) := by
    34	  classical
    35	  exact .quotient ⟨Finset.image relation Finset.univ, by simp⟩
    36	
    37	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
    38	-- Elaborating the dependent quotient inside the tensor product requires a larger typeclass budget.
    39	/-- Every finitely presented `K`-algebra, for an algebraic field extension `K/F`, is the
    40	base change of a finitely presented algebra over a finite subextension of `K/F`. -/
    41	theorem exists_finSubext_finitePresentation_algebra_model
    42	    {F K A : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    43	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    44	    [Algebra.FinitePresentation K A] :
    45	    ∃ L : FinSubext F K,
    46	      ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) L.1,
    47	        Nonempty (K ⊗[L.1] FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 n m relation ≃ₐ[K] A) := by
    48	  letI : Algebra F A := Algebra.compHom A (algebraMap F K)
    49	  letI : IsScalarTower F K A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    50	  let P := Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentation K A
    51	  let A0 : Subalgebra F K := Algebra.adjoin F P.coeffs
    52	  have hA0 : A0.FG := by
    53	    rw [Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType]
    54	    exact Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite P.finite_coeffs
    55	  letI : P.HasCoeffs A0 := by
    56	    refine ⟨?_⟩
    57	    intro x hx
    58	    exact ⟨⟨x, Algebra.subset_adjoin hx⟩, rfl⟩
    59	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F A0 :=
    60	    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective A0.val Subtype.val_injective
    61	  let L0 : IntermediateField F K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.toIntermediateField A0
    62	  letI : Algebra.FiniteType F L0 := by
    63	    change Algebra.FiniteType F A0
    64	    exact (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A0).mp hA0
    65	  letI : Module.Finite F L0 := Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
    66	  let L : FinSubext F K := ⟨L0, inferInstance⟩
    67	  letI : P.HasCoeffs L.1 := by
    68	    change P.HasCoeffs A0
    69	    infer_instance
    70	  refine ⟨L, Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentationVars K A,
    71	    Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentationRels K A,
    72	    P.relationOfHasCoeffs L.1, ?_⟩
    73	  exact ⟨P.tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv L.1⟩
    74	
    75	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
    76	-- The common coefficient algebra carries one dependent presentation instance per family member.
    77	/-- A finite family of finitely presented `K`-algebras is simultaneously defined over one
    78	finite subextension of an algebraic field extension `K/F`. -/
    79	theorem exists_finSubext_finitePresentation_algebra_model_finite
    80	    {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    81	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    82	    (A : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (A i)]
    83	    [∀ i, Algebra.FinitePresentation K (A i)] :
    84	    ∃ L : FinSubext F K,
    85	      ∀ i, ∃ n m : ℕ, ∃ relation : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) L.1,
    86	        Nonempty (K ⊗[L.1] FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 n m relation ≃ₐ[K] A i) := by
    87	  classical
    88	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    89	  let P (i : ι) := Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentation K (A i)
    90	  let A0i (i : ι) : Subalgebra F K := Algebra.adjoin F (P i).coeffs
    91	  have hA0i (i : ι) : (A0i i).FG := by
    92	    rw [Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType]
    93	    exact Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite (P i).finite_coeffs
    94	  let A0 : Subalgebra F K := Finset.univ.sup A0i
    95	  have hA0 : A0.FG := by
    96	    dsimp only [A0]
    97	    induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
    98	    | empty => simpa using (Subalgebra.fg_bot : (⊥ : Subalgebra F K).FG)
    99	    | @insert i s hi hs =>
   100	        simpa [Finset.sup_insert] using (hA0i i).sup hs
   101	  have hA0iA0 : ∀ i, A0i i ≤ A0 := fun i =>
   102	    Finset.le_sup (s := Finset.univ) (f := A0i) (Finset.mem_univ i)
   103	  letI (i : ι) : (P i).HasCoeffs A0 := by
   104	    refine ⟨?_⟩
   105	    intro x hx
   106	    exact ⟨⟨x, hA0iA0 i (Algebra.subset_adjoin hx)⟩, rfl⟩
   107	  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F A0 :=
   108	    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective A0.val Subtype.val_injective
   109	  let L0 : IntermediateField F K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.toIntermediateField A0
   110	  letI : Algebra.FiniteType F L0 := by
   111	    change Algebra.FiniteType F A0
   112	    exact (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A0).mp hA0
   113	  letI : Module.Finite F L0 := Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
   114	  let L : FinSubext F K := ⟨L0, inferInstance⟩
   115	  letI (i : ι) : (P i).HasCoeffs L.1 := by
   116	    change (P i).HasCoeffs A0
   117	    infer_instance
   118	  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
   119	  intro i
   120	  refine ⟨Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentationVars K (A i),
   121	    Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentationRels K (A i),
   122	    (P i).relationOfHasCoeffs L.1, ?_⟩
   123	  exact ⟨(P i).tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv L.1⟩
